title: Moroccan Kissed Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Moroccan dish featuring chicken cooked in a rich and spicy tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the with spices, chicken broth, and kissed.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Add the frais and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce over couscous or rice.
